description: What a word means, in thousands of languages — 8.15M dictionary entries with senses, part of speech, etymology and pronunciation. Covers what a general model is weakest at: historical languages (Old English, Gothic, Ancient Greek, Middle French) and hundreds of regional and indigenous ones. A single spelling often has entries in many languages and you get all of them — `hund` returns Danish, Gothic, Icelandic, Middle English and more — or pass `language` to narrow, `pos` for one part of speech. Use this for words and lookup() for things: define("java") gives the word in eight languages, lookup("Java") gives the island.

language.description: Optional language name as Wiktionary spells it, e.g. "English", "Latin", "Spanish".

pos.description: Optional part of speech filter, e.g. "Noun", "Verb", "Adjective".

word.description: The word or phrase to define.

name: define
